Company overview

A manpower partner from sourcing to on-ground support

Vistaraedge Private Limited supports organisations with end-to-end workforce requirements: identifying manpower needs, sourcing candidates, coordinating selection, deploying personnel and supporting workforce administration.

Our positioning

We are not only a recruitment vendor. We aim to be a workforce services partner, supporting the manpower lifecycle through sourcing, staffing, deployment coordination and related people-process administration.

Director’s vision

Building workforce partnerships people can rely on

“People are the engine of every business. Our vision is to be the partner that keeps that engine running, with dependable people, clear processes and honest communication.”

Vistaraedge is built to solve a simple problem: businesses lose time and productivity when manpower is not available on time, or when workforce administration is scattered across many vendors. We offer one coordinated partner, from sourcing and staffing to deployment and workforce support.

We believe every role matters, from the frontline associate on the warehouse floor to the professional in the front office. Our aim is to match the right people to the right roles, and to keep supporting them and our clients long after the joining date.

We hold ourselves to a clear scope, clear responsibilities and reporting backed by real operating data. That is how we want to earn trust, one engagement at a time.

Abhay KantDirector, Vistaraedge Private Limited

Our vision

To be a trusted workforce services partner for businesses and for the people who power them.

Our mission

To connect businesses with dependable people and manage the workforce processes behind them.

Our values

Dependability, transparency, respect for people and continuous improvement.

Working principles

Written scope
Every engagement begins with a written scope of work covering requirements, commercials, timelines and reporting.
Clear responsibilities
A responsibility matrix defines who handles recruitment, documents, attendance, payroll, compliance and supervision.
Honest reporting
Performance statements are backed by actual operating data, with targets and reporting frequency agreed with each client.

Frequently asked questions

Are you only a recruitment agency?

No. We aim to be a workforce services partner, supporting sourcing, staffing, deployment coordination and related workforce administration.

Can we use just one service?

Yes. Service lines can be engaged individually or combined, depending on your requirement and the agreed scope.

Who is responsible for statutory compliance?

Responsibilities are allocated in the written scope of work. Statutory obligations remain subject to applicable law and contract allocation.

Frequently asked questions

Do you run payroll?

We coordinate payroll-related processes such as input consolidation, data preparation and query coordination. Final payroll responsibilities are defined in the service agreement.

Do you supply security personnel?

We support security manpower through sourcing and deployment coordination, subject to required licences and applicable regulations.

How are services charged?

Through agreed recruitment fees, staffing or service charges and contracted support fees, depending on the service model. The structure is negotiated and documented with each client.

Not sure which service fits?

Tell us what you need and we will recommend a combination.

Engagement models

Volume-based

Defined headcount needs. We coordinate sourcing, selection and joining.

Location-based

One or multiple sites. We coordinate deployment and attendance follow-up.

Project-based

A defined project or business cycle. We coordinate mobilisation and replacements.

Ongoing

Recurring manpower supply. We coordinate contracted supply, reporting and reviews.

Where our teams work

From the warehouse floor to the front office.

Can you supply for multiple sites?

Yes. Location-based staffing supports deployment across one or multiple client sites.

What if a deployed person leaves?

Do you supply specialist roles?

How our model works

A structured workforce delivery cycle

  1. Requirement mapping

    Headcount, job descriptions, skills, experience, location, shifts, salary range and joining timelines.

  2. Sourcing & mobilisation

    Activate sourcing channels and build a candidate pipeline for the approved requirement.

  3. Screening & selection

    Review suitability, coordinate interviews and share profiles and selection updates.

  4. Documentation & joining

    Identity, employment and onboarding documents, joining confirmation and reporting instructions.

  5. Deployment & attendance

    Track deployment, attendance, shifts and manpower gaps through agreed reporting.

  6. Payroll & employee support

    Coordinate payroll inputs, employee queries and workforce administration within scope.

  7. Review & improvement

    Review fulfilment, attendance, attrition, payroll inputs and service performance with you.

What we need from you to start

  • Headcount and job descriptions
  • Skills and experience required
  • Work location and shift details
  • Salary range
  • Joining timelines

Transparent scope. Clear responsibilities.

Every engagement begins with a written scope of work.

Manpower requirement
Role, number of resources, skill profile, location, shift and start date.
Commercial terms
Wage components, service charges or staffing fee, taxes, billing cycle and payment terms.
Responsibility matrix
Who handles recruitment, documentation, attendance, payroll, compliance, supervision and facilities.
Service levels
Fulfilment timelines, replacement process, reporting frequency and escalation contacts.
Records & governance
Employee records, attendance reports, payroll inputs, invoices and compliance documents.

How billing works

We earn through agreed recruitment fees, staffing or service charges and contracted workforce support fees. In manpower supply arrangements, billing may be linked to deployed headcount, agreed wage costs and service charges. The exact structure is negotiated and documented with each client.

How soon can manpower be deployed?

Timelines depend on the role, location, volume and candidate availability, and are agreed in the scope of work.

How do we track progress?

Role trackers, joining updates, attendance inputs and escalation routes are agreed at the start.
